summary: Pre-fix reproduction only (no code changes). Confirmed at 390px mobile the hero Per-Order P&L card ([data-testid=hero-pnl-card]) is present in DOM but not visible because its ancestor wrapper <div class='hidden lg:block pl-6'> has computed display:none below the lg breakpoint (1024px). At 1920px desktop the same card renders correctly with all six rows (AOV, COGS, Blended CAC, Shipping+RTO, PG fee, Packaging+Ops), red CM2 -₹23/order line and green ROAS 4.1x badge. Navbar: [data-testid=nav-admin-link] 'Admin' link is visible on desktop (>=md) top-right; on mobile the hamburger menu (nav-mobile-menu) contains an 'Admin login' link at the bottom. Baseline captured; no fixes applied per request.

ui_bugs.issue: PnlCard wrapper uses 'hidden lg:block' which hides the card on all screens <1024px. Since ~99% of audience is mobile, they never see the hero visual. Wrapper is at /app/frontend/src/components/HeroSection.js line 182.
Public-facing 'Admin' link exposed in desktop navbar and mobile menu. User requested removal since /admin/login can be accessed directly by URL.

action_items: HeroSection.js line 182: change wrapper from 'hidden lg:block pl-6' so PnlCard renders on mobile too (e.g., 'block mt-10 lg:mt-0 lg:pl-6'); also ensure parent grid stacks cleanly on mobile and PnlCard is responsive (no fixed widths overflowing 390px).
Navbar.js: remove [data-testid=nav-admin-link] block (lines 54-59 keep only CTA) and remove the 'Admin login' <Link> at line 82 inside mobile menu.
After fix, retest at 390px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px to confirm PnlCard visibility and admin link removal.
critical_code_review_comments: Hiding the primary hero visual on all breakpoints below lg is a significant conversion risk for a mobile-first audience.
Exposing an 'Admin' link publicly is unnecessary attack-surface signalling; direct URL access is fine.
PnlCard component should be audited for min-width / absolute-positioned badges (ROAS 4.1x) that may overflow at 390px.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Post-fix testing should verify: (1) hero-pnl-card is visible at 390px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px with no horizontal overflow; (2) all 6 P&L rows + red CM2 line + green ROAS badge render on mobile; (3) nav-admin-link is absent on desktop; (4) mobile menu no longer contains 'Admin login'; (5) /admin/login route still works via direct URL. Preview URL: https://margin-recovery-3.preview.emergentagent.com
